<?php

class ModInt {
    public const MOD = 1000000007;
    public int $v;

    public function __construct(int $v) {
        $this->v = $v % self::MOD;
        if ($this->v < 0) $this->v += self::MOD;
    }

    public static function new(int $v): ModInt {
        return new ModInt($v);
    }

    public function add(ModInt $other): ModInt {
        $d = $this->v + $other->v;
        if ($d >= self::MOD) $d -= self::MOD;
        return new ModInt($d);
    }

    public function sub(ModInt $other): ModInt {
        $d = $this->v + self::MOD - $other->v;
        if ($d >= self::MOD) $d -= self::MOD;
        return new ModInt($d);
    }

    public function mul(ModInt $other): ModInt {
        $res = (int)(((int)$this->v * (int)$other->v) % self::MOD);
        return new ModInt($res);
    }

    public function pow(int $n): ModInt {
        $t = ModInt::new(1);
        $s = new ModInt($this->v);
        while ($n > 0) {
            if (($n & 1) === 1) {
                $t = $t->mul($s);
            }
            $s = $s->mul($s);
            $n >>= 1;
        }
        return $t;
    }

    public function divInt(int $other): ModInt {
        return $this->mul((new ModInt($other))->pow(self::MOD - 2));
    }

    public function div(ModInt $other): ModInt {
        return $this->mul($other->pow(self::MOD - 2));
    }

    public function neg(): ModInt {
        if ($this->v == 0) return new ModInt(0);
        return new ModInt(self::MOD - $this->v);
    }

    public function __toString(): string {
        return (string)$this->v;
    }
}

class Precalc {
    public int $n;
    /** @var ModInt[] */
    public array $inv;
    /** @var ModInt[] */
    public array $fact;
    /** @var ModInt[] */
    public array $ifact;

    public function __construct(int $n) {
        $this->n = $n;
        $this->inv = array_fill(0, $n + 1, new ModInt(1));
        $this->fact = array_fill(0, $n + 1, new ModInt(1));
        $this->ifact = array_fill(0, $n + 1, new ModInt(1));
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
            if ($i > 2) {
                $this->inv[$i] = $this->inv[ModInt::MOD % $i]->neg()->mul(new ModInt(intdiv(ModInt::MOD, $i)));
            }
            $this->fact[$i] = (new ModInt($i))->mul($this->fact[$i - 1]);
            $this->ifact[$i] = $this->inv[$i]->mul($this->ifact[$i - 1]);
        }
    }

    public function factVal(int $n): ModInt {
        return $this->fact[$n];
    }

    public function invVal(int $x): ModInt {
        return $this->inv[$x];
    }

    public function ifactVal(int $x): ModInt {
        return $this->ifact[$x];
    }

    public function comb(int $n, int $k): ModInt {
        if (!($k <= $n)) {
            return new ModInt(0);
        }
        return $this->fact[$n]->mul($this->ifact[$k])->mul($this->ifact[$n - $k]);
    }
}

class SquareMatrix {
    public int $n;
    /** @var ModInt[] */
    public array $a;

    public function __construct(int $n, array $a) {
        $this->n = $n;
        $this->a = $a;
    }

    public static function zero(int $n): SquareMatrix {
        $z = new ModInt(0);
        $a = array_fill(0, $n * $n, $z);
        return new SquareMatrix($n, $a);
    }

    public static function identity(int $n): SquareMatrix {
        $m = self::zero($n);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $m->a[$i * $n + $i] = new ModInt(1);
        }
        return $m;
    }

    public function set_at(int $i, int $j, ModInt $v): void {
        $this->a[$i * $this->n + $j] = $v;
    }

    public function get_at(int $i, int $j): ModInt {
        return $this->a[$i * $this->n + $j];
    }

    public static function matmul(SquareMatrix $l, SquareMatrix $r): SquareMatrix {
        return $l->mul($r);
    }

    public function add(SquareMatrix $rhs): SquareMatrix {
        $n = $this->n;
        $c = self::zero($n);
        $len = $n * $n;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $c->a[$i] = $this->a[$i]->add($rhs->a[$i]);
        }
        return $c;
    }

    public function mul(SquareMatrix $rhs): SquareMatrix {
        $n = $this->n;
        $c = self::zero($n);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            for ($k = 0; $k < $n; $k++) {
                $a = $this->a[$i * $n + $k];
                for ($j = 0; $j < $n; $j++) {
                    $idx_c = $i * $n + $j;
                    $idx_r = $k * $n + $j;
                    $c->a[$idx_c] = $c->a[$idx_c]->add($a->mul($rhs->a[$idx_r]));
                }
            }
        }
        return $c;
    }

    public function cloneMatrix(): SquareMatrix {
        $copy = [];
        foreach ($this->a as $v) {
            $copy[] = new ModInt($v->v);
        }
        return new SquareMatrix($this->n, $copy);
    }
}

function run(): void {
    $data = trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN));
    if ($data === '') return;
    $tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', $data);
    $it = 0;
    $n = intval($tokens[$it++]);
    $m = intval($tokens[$it++]);

    $t = SquareMatrix::identity($m);
    $s = SquareMatrix::zero($m);
    for ($i = 1; $i < $m; $i++) {
        $s->set_at($i - 1, $i, new ModInt(1));
    }
    $s->set_at($m - 1, 0, new ModInt(1));
    $s->set_at($m - 1, $m - 1, new ModInt(1));
    $nn = $n;
    while ($nn > 0) {
        if (($nn & 1) === 1) {
            $t = $t->mul($s->cloneMatrix());
        }
        $s = $s->cloneMatrix()->mul($s);
        $nn >>= 1;
    }
    $ans = $t->get_at($m - 1, $m - 1);
    echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
}

        $len = $n * $n;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $c->a[$i] = $this->a[$i]->add($rhs->a[$i]);
        }
        return $c;
    }

    public function mul(SquareMatrix $rhs): SquareMatrix {
        $n = $this->n;
        $c = SquareMatrix::zero($n);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            for ($k = 0; $k < $n; $k++) {
                $a = $this->a[$i * $n + $k];
                for ($j = 0; $j < $n; $j++) {
                    $idx_c = $i * $n + $j;
                    $idx_r = $k * $n + $j;
                    $c->a[$idx_c] = $c->a[$idx_c]->add($a->mul($rhs->a[$idx_r]));
                }
            }
        }
        return $c;
    }
}

function run() {
    $data = trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN));
    if ($data === '') return;
    $tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', $data);
    $it = 0;
    $n = intval($tokens[$it++]);
    $m = intval($tokens[$it++]);

    $t = SquareMatrix::identity($m);
    $s = SquareMatrix::zero($m);
    for ($i = 1; $i < $m; $i++) {
        $s->set_at($i - 1, $i, new ModInt(1));
    }
    $s->set_at($m - 1, 0, new ModInt(1));
    $s->set_at($m - 1, $m - 1, new ModInt(1));
    $nn = $n;
    while ($nn > 0) {
        if (($nn & 1) == 1) {
            $t = $t->mul(cloneMatrix($s));
        }
        $s = cloneMatrix($s)->mul($s);
        $nn >>= 1;
    }
    $ans = $t->get_at($m - 1, $m - 1);
    echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
}

function cloneMatrix(SquareMatrix $m): SquareMatrix {
    return new SquareMatrix($m->n, $m->a);
}

run();

source_data.prob_desc_description: Reziba has many magic gems. Each magic gem can be split into $$$M$$$ normal gems. The amount of space each magic (and normal) gem takes is $$$1$$$ unit. A normal gem cannot be split.Reziba wants to choose a set of magic gems and split some of them, so the total space occupied by the resulting set of gems is $$$N$$$ units. If a magic gem is chosen and split, it takes $$$M$$$ units of space (since it is split into $$$M$$$ gems); if a magic gem is not split, it takes $$$1$$$ unit.How many different configurations of the resulting set of gems can Reziba have, such that the total amount of space taken is $$$N$$$ units? Print the answer modulo $$$1000000007$$$ ($$$10^9+7$$$). Two configurations are considered different if the number of magic gems Reziba takes to form them differs, or the indices of gems Reziba has to split differ.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one integer, the total number of configurations of the resulting set of gems, given that the total amount of space taken is $$$N$$$ units. Print the answer modulo $$$1000000007$$$ ($$$10^9+7$$$).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The input contains a single line consisting of $$$2$$$ integers $$$N$$$ and $$$M$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 10^{18}$$$, $$$2 \le M \le 100$$$).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first example each magic gem can split into $$$2$$$ normal gems, and we know that the total amount of gems are $$$4$$$.Let $$$1$$$ denote a magic gem, and $$$0$$$ denote a normal gem.The total configurations you can have is:   $$$1 1 1 1$$$ (None of the gems split);  $$$0 0 1 1$$$ (First magic gem splits into $$$2$$$ normal gems);  $$$1 0 0 1$$$ (Second magic gem splits into $$$2$$$ normal gems);  $$$1 1 0 0$$$ (Third magic gem splits into $$$2$$$ normal gems);  $$$0 0 0 0$$$ (First and second magic gems split into total $$$4$$$ normal gems). Hence, answer is $$$5$$$.
